verdict.rationale: AgentMail's own hosted MCP server is documented in one version of its MCP docs as exposing "calendar tools". That is a first-party calendar capability, but it is only a passing mention with no detail, and other versions of the same page list tools without calendar. missing for 10: documentation of viewing a calendar, responding to invites, and creating events; any email-client UI where a power-user does this without leaving the inbox; hands-on or independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can see my calendar, respond to invites, and create events without leaving the email client

citations.quote: exposes inbox, message, thread, draft, attachment, and calendar tools
